note: BH-9938 (BH-9926 wave 6): settings row lane.dequeue-watch.gh_source. Where dequeue-watch's gather (bin/lib/dequeue-watch/gather.sh) reads the merge-queue and dequeued label lists, the newest Mergify payload (state, comment id, draft, run id, left sha, failing checks) and a MERGE verdict's lead-verdict status: off = GitHub only (today's reads); shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the lane acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record only, 0 GitHub calls on a hit, and a record miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS. Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Read by prr_step in bin/lib/prr-shadow.sh; the reads are bin/lib/prr-shadow.d/dequeue-watch.sh.
